1d50a2bd-0890-4b61-9474-b92435185adb@ufc.why: The vacant women's flyweight belt is on the line after champion Valentina Shevchenko was forced out by injury. Unbeaten #1 contender Natalia Silva, who has already beaten three former champions, meets #8 Wang Cong, a sharp finisher, for the new title. In the co-main, former two-time flyweight champ Deiveson Figueiredo tries to halt a rough skid against surging young striker Payton Talbott.
1d50a2bd-0890-4b61-9474-b92435185adb@ufc.know: A vacant title fight happens when a champion can't defend, so the two best available contenders fight for a fresh belt. Rankings run from champion down through number one to fifteen in each weight class, showing how title-worthy a fighter is seen to be. Figueiredo made his name at flyweight, a lighter division than the bantamweight he now fights in.

65476e3e-e4f9-4fb3-a5c0-3b852455ccfa@nin.why: The 49ers are 3-0 and sitting atop the NFC West, hosting a Denver team that enters 2-1 after bouncing back from a Week 1 blowout with solid wins over Jacksonville and the Rams. It is only Week 4, so nothing is clinched or lost here; a win would keep San Francisco perfect and show they can beat a legitimately good team, while a loss would be their first blemish but far from costly this early.
65476e3e-e4f9-4fb3-a5c0-3b852455ccfa@nin.know: In the NFL, each team plays 17 games, so four weeks in is just a small sample, early records matter less than how a team is trending. Watch Christian McCaffrey, the 49ers' do-it-all running back, and Broncos quarterback Bo Nix, who has quietly strung together two impressive wins after a rough season opener.
